GENERAL AWARD DTD 27.12.2022 IN RESPECT OF LAND BEARING SY.NO.26/1 MEASURING 0.26 GUNTAS VIDE KIADB/LAQ/1211/2022-23 ANNEXURE-C, GENERAL AWARD DTD 27.12.2022 IN RESPECT OF LAND BEARING SY.NO.84/4 MEASURING 0.37 GUNTAS VIDE KIADB/LAQ/1198/2022-23 ANNEXURE-D, AND AS PER GENERAL AWARD DTD 20.01.2023 IN RESPECT OF SY.NO.55/4 MEASURING 03.ACRE 15 GUNTAS VIDE KIADB/LAQ/1590/2022-23 ANNEXURE-E ALL PROPERTIES ARE SITUATED AT OBALAPURA VILLAGE, THYAMAGONDALU HOBLI, NELAMANGALA TALUK PASSED BY R3.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER R.DEVDAS J, (ORAL):
Learned HCGP takes notice for respondent No.1.
Learned Counsel Sri P.V.Chandrashekar, has entered appearance for respondents No.2 and 3-KIADB.

2. Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the General Awards have been passed only on the ground that the petitioners were absent when the matter was heard by the Special Land Acquisition Officer for award of NC: 2023:KHC:29303 compensation, as could be seen in the discussions made in the General Awards dated 27.12.2022 at Annexures-'B', 'C' & 'D' and General Award dated 20.01.2023 at Annexures-'E'.
3.

Learned Counsel submits that this Court has held in several matters including the recent decision in the case of Harisha.R /vs./ State of Karnataka and others in W.P.No.12703/2023 dated 27.06.2023 following an earlier decision in W.P.No. 6198/2015, that the land loser would be entitled for a better price as compensation instead of determination under General Awards.

entities.text: Harisha.R /vs./ State of Karnataka and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As a consequence, all such matters where it was found that General Awards was passed only on some technical ground that the land loser was not present at the time of hearing or such other technical reasons, this Court was of the considered opinion that since the land loser would get a better price if the compensation is awarded in terms of the agreement and not under General Awards, the award may be passed in terms of an agreement.
Therefore, the NC: 2023:KHC:29303 learned counsel submits that similar benefit should be given to the petitioners.

4. On going through the following judgments, which were rendered by this Court:
i) Smt. Rukmani v/s State of Karnataka Sri.

entities.text: Smt. Rukmani v/s State of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Srinivasaiah
V vs The State Of Karnataka
this Court is of the considered opinion that the petitioners are entitled for similar relief as was given in the cases mentioned hereinabove.

5. Consequently, the following:
ORDER (i) The writ petition is allowed.

NC: 2023:KHC:29303 (ii) The impugned General Awards dated 27.12.2022 at Annexures-'B', 'C' & 'D' and General Award dated 20.01.2023 at Annexure-'E' insofar as the petitioners' lands are concerned are set aside.

(iii) The respondent-Special Land Acquisition Officer, KIADB is directed to reconsider the request of the petitioners for award of compensation by way of an agreement under Section 29(2) of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, 1966 and pass necessary orders within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
(iv) The respondent - Special Land Acquisition Officer, KIADB, is at liberty to withdraw the amount that has been deposited by it pursuant to the General Awards before the jurisdictional Court.
(v) Needless to state that in the event of any dispute, the General Awards would stand restored.
Ordered accordingly.

NC: 2023:KHC:29303 Learned High Court Government Pleader and the learned Counsel for respondents No.2 and 3 are permitted to file Memo of appearance/Vakalath as the case may be,
